practicalCriteria: Every one of the 17 fields is completed, or marked not applicable with a reason in the field
The access method names who holds the access detail and where it is kept, and the brief contains no code, key number or alarm code
Every hazard row has a control, an owner and a review date
Every animal the client mentions is listed, and the team rule for animals and occupants is written
The client confirmation is recorded with its date and method before the first visit
passRule: assessor sign-off against rubric; no quiz pass
completionRule: assessor signs off the assembled document against the rubric; the learner receives the document on sign-off
stopWorkCriteria: Do not send the team to a site whose hazard row has no control until the owner has recorded one
